content.title: Saint John, U.S. Virgin Islands
content.text: From Simple English Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia 18°20′26″N 64°44′47″W / 18.34056°N 64.74639°W Map of the U.S. Virgin Islands. Saint John is an island in the Caribbean Sea. It is a constituent district of the United States Virgin Islands (USVI). It is the smallest of the three main USVI islands. St. John is about 4 miles east of Saint Thomas, and 4 miles south and west of Tortola, part of the British Virgin Islands. It is 50.8 km² (19.61 sq mi) in area. It has a population of 3,881 (2020 census).[1] ↑ "2020 Island Areas Censuses: U.S. Virgin Islands". US Census Bureau. Retrieved 2022-12-01.
